monsters.name: Slimes
monsters.where: The Mines floors 1-29 (Green Slime), 41-79 (Frost Jelly), 81-119 (Sludge); Mines slime-infested floors; Skull Cavern (purple Sludge)
monsters.whereSve: Secret Woods (extra seasonal slime spawns); Highlands (green/blue/red/purple slimes at night and in the ruins); Crimson Badlands and Castle Village Outpost (purple slimes)

monsters.name: Void Spirits
monsters.where: The Mines floors 81-119 (Shadow Brutes and Shamans); Dangerous Mines (Qi's Hard Mode, incl. Shadow Snipers); Wilderness Farm at night (late game)
monsters.whereSve: Highlands Cavern (shadow monsters, until a story event changes them); Highlands at night (shadow mobs); Dark Shrine of Invasion (Witch's Swamp area, needs an Ornate Treasure Chest offering): shadow monsters spawn at night in Town, Forest, Mountain, Beach, Bus Stop, Railroad, Backwoods, Secret Woods, Forest West, Blue Moon Vineyard, Adventurer Summit

monsters.name: Bats
monsters.where: The Mines floors 31-39 (Bat), 41-79 (Frost Bat), 81-119 (Lava Bat); Skull Cavern (Iridium Bat); Volcano Dungeon (bats)
monsters.whereSve: Highlands Cavern (bats plus random bat swarms); Dark Shrine of Invasion overworld spawns (Dangerous Bats)

monsters.name: Skeletons
monsters.where: The Mines floors 71-79 (dark floors); Dangerous Mines (Skeleton Mages)
monsters.whereSve: Castle Village Outpost (Dangerous Skeletons and Skeleton Mages); Crimson Badlands (Boneyard guards); Dark Shrine of Invasion overworld spawns

monsters.name: Cave Insects
monsters.where: The Mines floors 1-39 (Bugs); The Mines floors 41-79 (Grubs and Cave Flies); Mutant Bug Lair (Sewers, after 'Dark Talisman')

monsters.name: Duggies
monsters.where: The Mines floors 6-29 (dirt floors); Volcano Dungeon (Magma Duggy)

monsters.name: Dust Sprites
monsters.where: The Mines floors 41-79 (dark/ice floors 40s-70s, often in swarms on dark levels); Mines infested floors
monsters.whereSve: Highlands (Dangerous Dust Spirits, incl. green/white variants); Dark Shrine of Invasion overworld spawns

monsters.name: Rock Crabs
monsters.where: The Mines floors 1-29 (Rock Crab); The Mines floors 81-119 (Lava Crab); Skull Cavern (Iridium Crab)
monsters.whereSve: Highlands Cavern (Copper/Iron/Gold crabs, which are Rock Crab type); Forbidden Maze: Legendary Purple Mushroom Crab (Iridium Crab type, one per day after a story event)

monsters.name: Mummies
monsters.whereSve: Crimson Badlands (Evil/Corrupt Mummies and Fallen Adventurers, which are Mummy type); Iridium Quarry (Corrupt Mummies); Castle Village Outpost (Evil Mummies); Dark Shrine of Invasion overworld spawns

monsters.name: Pepper Rex
monsters.where: Skull Cavern prehistoric floors (random, floors 50+ typical); Dangerous Skull Cavern
monsters.whereSve: Highlands Cavern (Pepper Rex); Forbidden Maze (Poltergeist, which is Pepper Rex type); Highlands boss Bully Rex (Pepper Rex type, once)

monsters.name: Serpents
monsters.where: Skull Cavern (floors 1+; Royal Serpents deeper, floors ~50+); Skull Cavern 'serpent' (infested) floors
monsters.whereSve: Crimson Badlands (Badlands Serpent, Corrupt Serpent, Royal Badlands Serpent, Apophis)

monsters.name: Magma Sprites
monsters.reward: Marlon's phone number (call for the Item Recovery Service)

stardrops.name: Stardew Valley Fair
stardrops.how: Buy it for 2,000 star tokens at the Stardew Valley Fair (Fall 16). Earn tokens from the fair games and the Grange Display.
stardrops.prereq: Attend the Fair (Fall 16, 9am-3pm in Pelican Town). Usually takes more than one year's fair unless you do well at the games (slingshot, fishing, wheel, grange).

stardrops.name: Mines floor 100
stardrops.how: Open the treasure chest on floor 100 of the Mines.
stardrops.prereq: Reach floor 100 of the Mines (need a decent weapon and pickaxe).

stardrops.name: Spouse / roommate
stardrops.how: Your spouse or roommate (Krobus) gives it when friendship reaches 12.5 hearts (3,125 points); it appears in a gift box / is handed over when you talk to them at home. In multiplayer, two players marrying each other each get a gift box after the wedding.
stardrops.prereq: Marry a marriage candidate (or Krobus as roommate) and raise friendship past 12.5 hearts. Only one spouse stardrop per save, even after divorce and remarriage.

stardrops.name: Krobus's shop
stardrops.how: Buy it from Krobus in the Sewers for 20,000g.
stardrops.prereq: Rusty Key to enter the Sewers (donate 60 items to the Museum).

stardrops.name: Old Master Cannoli
stardrops.how: Give a Sweet Gem Berry to the Old Master Cannoli statue in the Secret Woods.
stardrops.prereq: Secret Woods access (Steel Axe or better to cut the large log). Sweet Gem Berry is grown from Rare Seeds (Traveling Cart, 1,000g; or crafted via Seed Maker). Rare Seeds grow in Spring/Summer only (24 days) unless in the Greenhouse/Ginger Island.

stardrops.name: Master Angler
stardrops.how: Willy mails it the day after you earn the Master Angler achievement (catch every fish in the fishing collection).
stardrops.prereq: Catch every fish counted in the Fish collection tab, including legendaries, night-market fish and crab-pot catches.

stardrops.name: Museum collection
stardrops.how: Gunther gives it as the reward for donating all 95 artifacts and minerals to the Museum.
stardrops.prereq: Donate all 42 artifacts and 53 minerals to the Museum (95 items).

walnuts.title: Golden Coconut
walnuts.hint: Clint knows how to crack something hard and gold from the island.
walnuts.solution: Bring a Golden Coconut (dropped by palm/coconut trees on Ginger Island) to Clint at the Blacksmith; the first one he opens contains a Golden Walnut.

walnuts.title: Island fishing
walnuts.hint: Something nutty is deep in the island's waters.
walnuts.solution: Fish anywhere on Ginger Island; each cast has a 15% chance to give a walnut until 5 have been found this way.

walnuts.title: Jungle path bush
walnuts.hint: A bush on the jungle path toward Leo looks suspiciously full.
walnuts.solution: Shake the walnut bush in the open center of the jungle on the path to Leo's hut (17,37).

walnuts.title: Banana shrine
walnuts.hint: The jungle altar by Leo's stairs wants a fruit offering.
walnuts.solution: Place a Banana on the altar near the staircase to Leo's hut; the gorilla gives 3 walnuts.

walnuts.title: Leo's hut tree
walnuts.hint: The tree in Leo's hut might drop something if you get chopping.
walnuts.solution: Hit the tree inside Leo's hut with an axe.

walnuts.title: Gem Bird Shrine bush
walnuts.hint: Look around the hidden shrine east of Leo's stairs.
walnuts.solution: From the foot of Leo's stairs follow the hidden passage east to the Gem Bird Shrine; shake the bush on the south edge of the shrine area (23,34).

walnuts.title: Gem Bird puzzle
walnuts.hint: The hidden shrine's pedestals need gems carried by birds.
walnuts.solution: Find the 5 gem birds around the island (each one names its gem: Amethyst, Aquamarine, Emerald, Ruby, Topaz) and place each gem on its matching pedestal in the Gem Bird Shrine.

walnuts.title: Island farm crops
walnuts.hint: Crops grown on the island farm sometimes yield more than vegetables.
walnuts.solution: Harvest non-regrowing crops (by hand or Iridium Scythe, not scythe-only crops) on the Ginger Island farm; 5% chance each to give a walnut, up to 5.

walnuts.title: Gourmand Frog: Melon
walnuts.hint: Kribbit... the frog in the farm cave is hungry for something summery and sweet.
walnuts.solution: After repairing the Island Farmhouse, talk to the Gourmand Frog in the cave; grow a Melon on the island farm and show it to him while still unharvested.

walnuts.title: Gourmand Frog: Wheat
walnuts.hint: The frog's second request is a grain.
walnuts.solution: Grow Wheat on the island farm and show it to the Gourmand Frog unharvested (after the Melon).

walnuts.title: Gourmand Frog: Garlic
walnuts.hint: The frog's last request is pungent.
walnuts.solution: Grow Garlic on the island farm and show it to the Gourmand Frog unharvested (after the Wheat).

walnuts.title: Journal Scrap #6 treasure
walnuts.hint: A journal scrap describes a curved palm on the farm's beach.
walnuts.solution: After reading Journal Scrap #6, dig in the southeast corner of the beach south of the island farm, where the eastern cliff meets the northern cliff by the curved palm (104,74).

walnuts.title: Mussel stones
walnuts.hint: Stuck in shelly stones by the shore.
walnuts.solution: Break Mussel Nodes on the beach south of the island farm; 10% chance each, up to 5.

walnuts.title: Shipwreck
walnuts.hint: The wrecked ship on the beach might have a way inside.
walnuts.solution: Enter the shipwreck on the southwest beach south of the farm via the hidden path at its west corner; shake the plant inside (2,4).

walnuts.title: Whack-a-mole
walnuts.hint: Something pops in and out of holes on the beach south of Birdie's hut.
walnuts.solution: Block 3 of the mole's 4 holes with placeable objects, then hit it with an axe, pickaxe or watering can (an upgraded watering can works without blocking).

walnuts.title: Blue starfish triangle
walnuts.hint: Starfish on the farm beach point to a spot.
walnuts.solution: Dig in the center of the blue starfish triangle among the debris on the beach south of the farm (62,76).

walnuts.title: Starfish diamond by tide pools
walnuts.hint: Starfish near the tide pools frame a spot, maybe under a rock.
walnuts.solution: Dig the center of the starfish diamond by the tide pools; it may be covered by a large boulder (43,74).

walnuts.title: X in the tide pools
walnuts.hint: X marks the spot.
walnuts.solution: Dig at the X drawn in the sand among the tide pools (30,75).

walnuts.title: Sand indents diamond
walnuts.hint: Odd dents in the dark sand near the ocean.
walnuts.solution: Dig the center of the diamond of indents in the sand southwest of the tide pools, near the ocean (21,81).

walnuts.title: Pond palm bush
walnuts.hint: Check behind the trees by the pond.
walnuts.solution: Shake the bush behind the palm tree by the pond west of the farm / west of Birdie's hut (38,56).

walnuts.title: The Pirate's Wife
walnuts.hint: Help man in tent.
walnuts.solution: Complete Birdie's quest 'The Pirate's Wife'; the reward includes 5 walnuts.

walnuts.title: Journal Scrap #4 treasure
walnuts.hint: A journal scrap hints at treasure near Birdie's hut.
walnuts.solution: After reading Journal Scrap #4, dig in the sand just north of Birdie's hut between the bush clumps (18,42); also gives a Quality Bobber.

walnuts.title: Bush outside Qi's room
walnuts.hint: Walk up the west coast toward the walnut door.
walnuts.solution: Shake the bush to the lower right of Qi's Walnut Room door, along the wall near the cliff (25,30).

walnuts.title: Bush past Qi's room
walnuts.hint: The coastline keeps going past the walnut door.
walnuts.solution: Walk north past Qi's Walnut Room through the shallow ocean water to a walnut bush (15,3).

walnuts.title: Tiger slimes
walnuts.hint: Stripey slimes to the west carry something.
walnuts.solution: Kill Tiger Slimes in the Tiger Slime Grove; one will drop 1 walnut.

walnuts.title: Mahogany tree bush
walnuts.hint: A mahogany tree in the slime grove hides something.
walnuts.solution: Shake the bush behind the mahogany tree in the Tiger Slime Grove (31,24).

walnuts.title: Grass circle in slime grove
walnuts.hint: A ring of grass in the slime grove looks deliberate.
walnuts.solution: Dig the center of the circle of grass in the Tiger Slime Grove, likely hidden behind a Mahogany Tree (39,24).

walnuts.title: Bush by the west bridge
walnuts.hint: Cross the bridge west of the farm's parrot stop and hug the southern wall.
walnuts.solution: From the farm Parrot Express station go west over the river bridge; the bush is partially hidden by the southern wall/trees on the path between the slime grove and the suspension bridge (54,18).

walnuts.title: Simon Says crystals
walnuts.hint: A hidden cave north of the slime grove sings in colors.
walnuts.solution: In the cave north of the Tiger Slime Grove, repeat the colored-crystal sequences (Simon Says) until solved.

walnuts.title: Cliff edge bush
walnuts.hint: Follow the cliff edge east of the slime grove, clearing debris.
walnuts.solution: Go east from the Tiger Slime Grove along the elevated cliff edge on the west side of the river, breaking rocks/weeds; the bush is at the end of the path (64,30).

walnuts.title: Pebble diamond
walnuts.hint: Pebbles east of the farm's parrot stop form a shape.
walnuts.solution: Dig the center of the diamond of pebbles east of the farm Parrot Express station, in the grassy northeast (88,14).

walnuts.title: Hidden path bush (NE)
walnuts.hint: A hidden trail jogs east and north from the farm's parrot stop.
walnuts.solution: East of the farm Parrot Express, follow the hidden path through dense trees east then north to its end (104,3).

walnuts.title: Bush overlooking the farmhouse
walnuts.hint: The cliff above the farmhouse has a view and a bush.
walnuts.solution: South of the farm Parrot Express, follow the cliff south then east above the farmhouse to the bush (75,29).

walnuts.title: Stone circle west of stairs
walnuts.hint: Buried near a curved tree west of the entrance stairs.
walnuts.solution: At the top of the Island North entrance stairs, turn west and dig the center of the stone circle beneath the curved tree (26,81).

walnuts.title: Hidden grove west of stairs
walnuts.hint: A hidden passage west of the entrance stairs.
walnuts.solution: At the top of the entrance stairs, go west through the hidden passage in the trees to a grove with a walnut bush (9,84).

walnuts.title: Flower circle
walnuts.hint: Flowers in the grass northeast of the stairs form a ring.
walnuts.solution: Northeast of the entrance stairs, dig the center of the circle of flowers/long grass in the dark grassy area (42,77).

walnuts.title: Second stone circle (east)
walnuts.hint: Continue east from the flower ring to another grassy patch.
walnuts.solution: From the flower circle go east to the next grassy area (southeast corner) and dig the center of the stone circle on the sand patch (57,79).

walnuts.title: Odd soil near Field Office
walnuts.hint: Sand southeast of the Field Office looks disturbed.
walnuts.solution: Dig the raised, odd-textured sand at the NE corner of the path between the docks and the Island Field Office (62,54).

walnuts.title: Dig site stone circle
walnuts.hint: Up the steps from the dig site, rocks form a ring.
walnuts.solution: Climb the north steps of the dig site and dig the center of the stone circle (19,39).

walnuts.title: Dig site west bush
walnuts.hint: Over the bridge west of the dig site steps.
walnuts.solution: Up the north steps of the dig site, cross the bridge west to the walnut plant in the grassy area above the dig site (4,42).

walnuts.title: Two bushes east of dig site
walnuts.hint: A hidden passage in the cliff east of the dig site steps.
walnuts.solution: Up the north steps of the dig site, go east through the hidden cliff passage and across the bridge to two walnut plants in the grass above the Field Office (45,38) and (47,40).

walnuts.title: Bush behind tree by volcano
walnuts.hint: Southeast of the volcano entrance, a tree hides a plant.
walnuts.solution: Shake the walnut plant hidden behind the coconut tree southeast of the Volcano Dungeon entrance (56,27).

walnuts.title: Sand nook east of volcano
walnuts.hint: East of the volcano entrance, bushes and stones cradle a sandy spot.
walnuts.solution: Dig the sand circled by two bushes and an arc of stones east of the Volcano Dungeon entrance, along the volcano's eastern edge (54,21).

walnuts.title: Walnut in a tree (slingshot)
walnuts.hint: Something is stuck high in a curved tree on the volcano's side.
walnuts.solution: Northeast of the Volcano Dungeon entrance, shoot the walnut out of the curved tree with a slingshot.

walnuts.title: Journal Scrap #10 treasure
walnuts.hint: A journal scrap mentions a looping palm near the volcano.
walnuts.solution: After reading Journal Scrap #10, dig the tile inside the loop of the curved palm growing out of the cliff southwest of the volcano entrance (27,28).

walnuts.title: Far NW stone circle
walnuts.hint: Where Leo sometimes stands, at the far northwest.
walnuts.solution: Dig the center of the stone circle at the extreme northwest of the map, on the cliff edge west of the volcano (19,13).

walnuts.title: Secluded NW bush
walnuts.hint: West of the volcano, follow the wall to a hidden passage.
walnuts.solution: At the far northwest, west of the volcano, go west along the wall and a notch north through the hidden passage to a secluded bush (20,26).

walnuts.title: Down the fire river
walnuts.hint: Fire mountain... hidden down fire river.
walnuts.solution: Inside the volcano entrance, water the lava river with a Watering Can to make a path west, then south to the landing near the river's end; exit south into an open area with two bushes (13,33) and (5,30).

walnuts.title: Upper cliff bush (via Island North)
walnuts.hint: A bush on the cliff above Island South is reachable from the north side.
walnuts.solution: Go up the stairs to Island North, turn east immediately, then go south through a hidden route behind a tree to the bush on the upper cliff of Island South (31,5). Parrot hints count this one as 'north'.

walnuts.title: Large Animal skeleton
walnuts.hint: The professor at the dig site wants a big skeleton reassembled.
walnuts.solution: Donate all Large Animal bones to the Island Field Office: Fossilized Skull, Fossilized Spine, Fossilized Tail, Fossilized Leg x2, Fossilized Ribs.

walnuts.title: Snake skeleton
walnuts.hint: The professor wants a long, slithery skeleton.
walnuts.solution: Donate Snake Skull and Snake Vertebrae x2 to the Island Field Office.

walnuts.title: Mummified Frog
walnuts.hint: A dried-up amphibian belongs in the Field Office.
walnuts.solution: Donate a Mummified Frog (found cutting weeds in the jungle) to the Island Field Office.

walnuts.title: Mummified Bat
walnuts.hint: A dried-up flier belongs in the Field Office.
walnuts.solution: Donate a Mummified Bat (from breaking rocks in the Volcano Dungeon) to the Island Field Office.

walnuts.title: Purple Flowers survey
walnuts.hint: Count the purple flowers on the island.
walnuts.solution: Answer the Purple Flowers Island Survey at the Field Office: 22.

walnuts.title: Purple Starfish survey
walnuts.hint: Count the purple starfish on the island.
walnuts.solution: Answer the Purple Starfish Island Survey at the Field Office: 18.

walnuts.title: Volcano rocks
walnuts.hint: Nutty stone in fire mountain.
walnuts.solution: Break rocks in the Volcano Dungeon; up to 5 walnuts.

walnuts.title: Volcano monsters
walnuts.hint: Taken by monsters in fire mountain.
walnuts.solution: Kill monsters in the Volcano Dungeon; up to 5 walnuts.

walnuts.title: Volcano crates
walnuts.hint: Encased in fire mountain gadgets.
walnuts.solution: Break metal crates/barrels in the Volcano Dungeon; up to 5 walnuts.

walnuts.title: Volcano common chest
walnuts.hint: Hidden in fire mountain treasures.
walnuts.solution: Open a common chest in the Volcano Dungeon; the first gives a walnut.

walnuts.title: Volcano rare chest
walnuts.hint: Hidden in fire mountain treasures.
walnuts.solution: Open a rare chest in the Volcano Dungeon; the first gives a walnut.

walnuts.title: Caldera (Forge) plants
walnuts.hint: Atop fire mountain.
walnuts.solution: Reach the Forge (Volcano Caldera, after level 9) and shake the walnut plants along its southern edge, one near the entrance and one near the exit (28,36) and (9,34).

walnuts.title: Star pool fishing
walnuts.hint: Bathing in the heart of the star.
walnuts.solution: After the Island Resort is built, fish in the starfish-shaped tide pool in Island Southeast; the first catch gives a walnut.

walnuts.title: Yellow starfish diamond
walnuts.hint: Yellow starfish on the southeast beach frame a spot.
walnuts.solution: In Island Southeast (after the resort), dig the center of the yellow starfish diamond northeast of the star pool (25,17).

walnuts.title: Mermaid's song
walnuts.hint: On rainy days, a mermaid listens from a rock in the southeast.
walnuts.solution: On a rainy day in Island Southeast, place a Flute Block above/below each of the 5 stone groups on the shore, tune each by its stones (big stone = 5, small = 1; wiki key: 2, 11, 9, 5, 7 clicks from a fresh block, or 1, 10, 8, 4, 6), then walk past them left to right to play the Mermaid's song.

walnuts.title: Darts
walnuts.hint: Pirates play a game at night in the cove.
walnuts.solution: On a non-rainy night after 8 PM on an even-numbered day, win darts against the pirates in the Pirate Cove (after the resort); 1 walnut per win, up to 3.

walnuts.title: Pirate Cove buried
walnuts.hint: Buried... Pirate's cove.
walnuts.solution: In the Pirate Cove (after the resort), dig the exposed sand among the barrels east of the water, across from the dock (36,26).

festivals.name: Egg Festival
festivals.fishing: Pelican Town becomes the festival map while the festival runs; the town river cannot be fished during it. Time does not pass inside.

festivals.name: Desert Festival
festivals.fishing: Normal fishing everywhere. Willy runs daily fishing challenges for Calico Eggs (Spring 15: catch 3 Sandfish; 16: catch a Scorpion Carp; 17: Golden Bobber from first fishing treasure chest).

festivals.name: Flower Dance
festivals.fishing: Cindersap Forest is the festival map during the event; forest river/pond fishing unavailable while it runs.

festivals.name: Luau
festivals.fishing: The Beach is the festival map; ocean fishing at the Beach unavailable during it. Willy's Fish Shop closed.

festivals.name: Trout Derby
festivals.fishing: POSITIVE: Rainbow Trout can be caught all day in the Cindersap Forest river regardless of weather/time. Each Rainbow Trout has 33% chance to give a Golden Tag (prizes: Tent Kit first, then Bucket Hat, Mounted Trout, etc.).

festivals.name: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
festivals.fishing: Beach fishing after 10pm is replaced by the festival.

festivals.name: Stardew Valley Fair
festivals.fishing: Town becomes the festival map; town river fishing unavailable. Fishing minigame booth (Willy) awards Star Tokens.

festivals.name: Spirit's Eve
festivals.fishing: Town fishing after 10pm replaced by festival.

festivals.name: Festival of Ice
festivals.fishing: Cindersap Forest is the festival map; normal forest fishing unavailable while it runs. Ice Fishing Contest (catch 5+ fish to win; rod provided; first win: Sailor's Cap + 2 tackle + Magnet; later Prize Ticket).

festivals.name: SquidFest
festivals.fishing: POSITIVE: Squid can be caught all day at the Beach (normally 6pm-2am). Daily prize tiers: Winter 12 needs 1/3/5/8 squid, Winter 13 needs 2/5/7/10 (counter resets each day). Prizes include 'Squid Kid', Squid Hat, The Art O' Crabbing.

festivals.name: Night Market
festivals.fishing: POSITIVE: Deep-sea Fishing Submarine (1,000g, board 5pm-11pm, fish until 2am) is the only place to catch Midnight Squid, Spook Fish and Blobfish (without Magic Bait). Normal Beach fishing still works outside the submarine.

festivals.name: Feast of the Winter Star
festivals.fishing: Town becomes the festival map; town river fishing unavailable.

festivals.name: Community Day
festivals.fishing: No fishing restriction.
festivals.note: Complete the Community Center (event 191393 seen). Lewis visits your farm on the 21st of the first season after completion to announce it.
